title: 第399章 番外：权臣在现代（五）
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

出门后，宋雲初的视线紧随着男人，见男人走向了电梯，便也跟着走了过去，期间拿出手机随手点了个淘宝低头看，只用余光瞥着那人的动静。

两人都在等电梯，男人注意到了旁边有人，转头看了一眼。

唔，这个妹子刚才在直播间里见过，好像是小安带过来的朋友？

看起来有点儿高冷，这种类型应该不好泡。

还是先把小安搞到手再说。

电梯上来了，男人的视线从宋雲初身上收回，踏进了电梯里。

电梯里这会儿有不少人，宋雲初进去后，看见男人按了1层，就随手按了3层。

电梯缓缓下降，到了3层时，宋雲初踏出电梯便迅速下到1层，来到了大厦外的便利店旁边。

片刻后，她就看见男人的身影从大厦走了出来。

宋雲初将手机调成静音，悄悄跟上。

男人来到路牌边点了根烟，拿出手机拨了一通电话。

“小芬，你这么搞真没意思，咱们才谈了没多久，你就想用孩子赖上我了？叫你打你不打，开播前晕倒了还要怪我头上？最近公司这么忙，你能不能别添乱？”

“结婚，你他妈开什么玩笑。咱们这行吃的是青春饭，你以为结婚是容易的事吗？我现在只想搞事业，不考虑结婚，最起码要过个三五年。”

“你非要把事情闹大的话，别人也只会嘲笑你。赶紧把这事处理了你还能留下来继续干，不然闹到最后还得是你走人。”

“什么我劈腿？我不就出去喝了几杯酒，你他妈有病……”

男人骂了一通脏话后挂了电话，将手里剩下的小半截烟扔在地上踩灭。

随后他拦了一辆出租车，上车离开。

榕树后方，宋雲初望着那辆出租车，直到车子在视野中变成一个小点，这才跨出了脚步。

回到直播间时，祝卿安依旧在对着镜头介绍护肤产品。

宋雲初则是竟春节是掏玩家钱包的好时机。

晚11点，祝卿安结束了工作，来到宋雲初身旁，“我以为你在这坐半个小时就会受不了了，没想到真坐了三小时，我刚都跟你说了，要是无聊可以先回去的。”

“没事，反正我打游戏，顺便等你，咱们互不影响。”

“我同事里也有人在打逐梦三界，其实我也想玩，但是怕没人带，听说里面组队要看战力。”

“不建议你玩。”宋雲初好言相劝，“太烧钱了，以你的消费水平，入坑就得荷包大出血。”

“有这么夸张吗？”

“一套限定锦衣两千起步，稀有宠物抽奖有一半都是内部人员。普通玩家又肝又氪还只能当小弟，这是个无底洞，想进名人堂被人追捧，至少得充五十万。”

祝卿安诧异，“五十万？！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After going out, Song Yunchu followed the man closely. When he saw the man walking towards the elevator, he followed him. During this period, he took out his mobile phone and clicked Taobao and looked down, only glancing at the man's movements with his peripheral vision.

Both of them were waiting for the elevator. The man noticed someone next to him and turned his head to look.

Well, I saw this girl in the live broadcast room just now. She seems to be a friend brought here by Xiao An?

It looks a bit aloof, this type should be difficult to pick up.

Let’s get Xiao An first.

The elevator came up, and the man withdrew his eyes from Song Yunchu and stepped into the elevator.

There were many people in the elevator at the moment. After Song Yunchu entered, he saw the man pressing the button for the first floor, so he casually pressed the button for the third floor.

The elevator descended slowly. When it reached the third floor, Song Yunchu stepped out of the elevator and quickly went down to the first floor, arriving at the convenience store outside the building.

A moment later, she saw the man's figure walking out of the building.

Song Yunchu muted his cell phone and followed quietly.

The man came to the street sign, lit a cigarette, took out his mobile phone and made a call.

"Xiao Fen, it's really boring for you to do this. We've only been talking for a long time, and you want to use your child to rely on me? I told you to beat me, but you won't beat me. If you fainted before the show started, you still blame me? The company is so busy recently, can you please stop causing trouble?"

"Getting married, what the hell are you kidding me about. We are in this industry where we are young. Do you think getting married is easy? I just want to pursue a career now and don't think about getting married. It will take at least three to five years."

"If you insist on making things bigger, others will just laugh at you. If you deal with this matter quickly, you can still stay and continue to work, otherwise you will have to leave in the end."

"Why am I cheating? I just went out and drank a few glasses of wine. You are fucking sick..."

The man cursed a bunch of curse words and then hung up the phone. He threw the remaining half of the cigarette on the ground and stamped it out.

He then hailed a taxi, got in and left.

Behind the banyan tree, Song Yunchu looked at the taxi until the car turned into a small dot in his field of vision, then he took a step forward.

When he returned to the live broadcast room, Zhu Qingan was still introducing skin care products to the camera.

Song Yunchu thought that the Spring Festival was a good time to dig into players' wallets.

At 11 o'clock in the evening, Zhu Qing'an finished her work and came to Song Yunchu's side, "I thought you wouldn't be able to bear it if you sat here for half an hour, but I didn't expect you would sit here for three hours. I just told you, if you are bored, you can go back first."

"It's okay. I'm playing games anyway and waiting for you. We won't affect each other."

"Some of my colleagues are also playing Dream Chasers Three Realms. I actually want to play too, but I'm afraid no one will lead me. I heard that team formation depends on combat strength."

"I don't recommend you to play." Song Yunchu persuaded him kindly, "It's too expensive. With your consumption level, you will lose a lot of money if you fall into the trap."

"Is it that exaggerated?"

"A set of limited-edition brocade clothes starts at NT$2,000, and half of the rare pet lottery draws are made by insiders. Ordinary players are greedy and can only be treated as underlings. This is a bottomless pit. If you want to enter the Hall of Fame and be sought after, you have to top up at least 500,000."

Zhu Qing'an was surprised, "Five hundred thousand?!"
